cards.example_en: You'll find the full recipe in the appendix.
cards.example_zh: 你可以在附录里找到完整的食谱。
cards.explain_zh: 附录复数可用appendices；阑尾常用appendixes。

cards.example_en: You'll find the full recipe in the appendix.
cards.example_zh: 你可以在附录里找到完整的食谱。

cards.example_en: The audience burst into applause as the curtain fell.
cards.example_zh: 幕布落下时，观众爆发出热烈的掌声。
cards.explain_zh: 不可数；“一阵掌声”用 a round of applause。

cards.example_en: The audience burst into applause as the curtain fell.
cards.example_zh: 幕布落下时，观众爆发出热烈的掌声。

cards.example_en: I packed an apple and a sandwich for lunch.
cards.example_zh: 我装了一个苹果和一个三明治当午餐。
cards.explain_zh: 可数名词；“一个苹果”用an apple。

cards.example_en: Can you give me an approximate price for the repairs?
cards.example_zh: 你能告诉我维修大概要多少钱吗？
cards.explain_zh: 形容词词尾读/mət/，动词词尾读/meɪt/。

cards.example_en: My budget is only a rough approximation of the cost.
cards.example_zh: 我的预算只是对费用的粗略估计。
cards.explain_zh: 常用an approximation of；强调接近但并不精确。

cards.example_en: My budget is only a rough approximation of the cost.
cards.example_zh: 我的预算只是对费用的粗略估计。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Her choice felt arbitrary: she picked without even looking.
cards.example_zh: 她的选择显得很随意：她连看都没看就选了。
cards.explain_zh: 重点是缺乏合理依据，不只是“可以自由选择”。

cards.example_en: Studying archaeology taught her to recognise ancient pottery fragments.
cards.example_zh: 学习考古学让她学会了辨认古代陶器碎片。
cards.explain_zh: 通常不可数；研究恐龙化石属于古生物学。

cards.example_en: The architect showed us a model of our future home.
cards.example_zh: 建筑师给我们看了未来新家的模型。
cards.explain_zh: architect指人，architecture指建筑学或建筑风格。

cards.example_en: The bakery displayed a colourful array of cakes.
cards.example_zh: 面包店陈列着各式各样、色彩缤纷的蛋糕。
cards.explain_zh: 常见a wide array of，强调数量多、种类丰富。

cards.example_en: Modern universities offer a wide array of courses to meet the demands of a changing labour market.
cards.example_zh: 现代大学提供广泛的课程，以满足不断变化的劳动力市场需求。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Follow the arrow on the floor to the exit.
cards.example_zh: 沿着地板上的箭头走到出口。
cards.explain_zh: arrow既指弓射出的“箭”，也指示方向的“箭头”。

cards.example_en: Follow the arrow on the floor to the exit.
cards.example_zh: 沿着地板上的箭头走到出口。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Our articulate neighbour explained the problem clearly at dinner.
cards.example_zh: 我们那位善于表达的邻居在晚餐时把问题解释得很清楚。
cards.explain_zh: 形容词词尾读/lət/，动词词尾读/leɪt/。

cards.example_en: Each artifact in the exhibition has a description of its origin.
cards.example_zh: 展览中的每件文物都有关于其来源的说明。

cards.example_en: The artificial flowers looked surprisingly fresh on the table.
cards.example_zh: 桌上的仿真花看起来竟然像鲜花一样。
cards.explain_zh: artificial指人造的；artistic才是艺术的。

cards.example_en: The discussion examines the use of artificial intelligence in education.
cards.example_zh: 讨论考察人工智能在教育中的应用。

cards.example_en: The festival celebrates artistic traditions through music and dance.
cards.example_zh: 这个节日通过音乐和舞蹈颂扬艺术传统。
cards.explain_zh: artistic指艺术或艺术天赋；artificial指人造的。

cards.example_en: Schools should provide opportunities for artistic expression, as creative activities can support emotional development and cultural understanding.
cards.example_zh: 学校应提供艺术表达的机会，因为创意活动有助于情感发展和文化理解。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Teachers can pin students' artwork to classroom walls to celebrate creativity and encourage participation.
cards.example_zh: 教师可以把学生的美术作品钉在教室墙上，以肯定创造力并鼓励参与。
cards.source: Word Atlas context; product gloss correction

cards.example_en: Teamwork is one aspect of a good class project.
cards.example_zh: 团队合作是做好课堂作业的一个方面。

cards.example_en: The whole school gathered in the hall for assembly.
cards.example_zh: 全校师生聚在礼堂里参加集会。
cards.explain_zh: 集会义通常可数；组装义通常不可数。

cards.example_en: Some educators assert that regular feedback improves student motivation more effectively than frequent formal examinations.
cards.example_zh: 一些教育工作者坚称，定期反馈比频繁的正式考试更能有效提高学生的学习积极性。
cards.explain_zh: assert强调坚定表态，不代表已经提供证据。

cards.example_en: Some educators assert that regular feedback improves student motivation more effectively than frequent formal examinations.
cards.example_zh: 一些教育工作者坚称，定期反馈比频繁的正式考试更能有效提高学生的学习积极性。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I finished my science assignment before dinner last night.
cards.example_zh: 昨晚我在晚饭前完成了科学作业。
cards.explain_zh: 指具体作业时可数；homework通常不可数。

cards.example_en: My athletic brother plays both football and basketball.
cards.example_zh: 我那健壮的哥哥既踢足球又打篮球。

cards.example_en: We cannot see an atom even with the school microscope.
cards.example_zh: 即使用学校的显微镜，我们也看不见原子。

cards.example_en: Our teacher used coloured balls to explain atomic structure.
cards.example_zh: 老师用彩色小球来解释原子结构。
cards.explain_zh: atomic强调原子；nuclear更侧重原子核或核能。

cards.example_en: Our teacher used coloured balls to explain atomic structure.
cards.example_zh: 老师用彩色小球来解释原子结构。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My aunt bought this old clock at an auction.
cards.example_zh: 我姑姑在一次拍卖会上买下了这座旧钟。
cards.explain_zh: at auction可不加冠词；auction off表示拍卖掉。

cards.example_en: The audio guide described each painting in the museum.
cards.example_zh: 音频导览介绍了博物馆里的每一幅画。

cards.example_en: An annual audit helps the charity explain how donations are spent.
cards.example_zh: 年度审计帮助慈善机构说明捐款的使用方式。

cards.example_en: Only the manager has authority to approve this refund.
cards.example_zh: 只有经理有权批准这笔退款。
cards.explain_zh: 表权力通常不可数；the authorities常指当局。

cards.example_en: Local authorities should consult residents before introducing policies that significantly affect access to public services.
cards.example_zh: 地方当局在推出显著影响公共服务获取的政策前，应征求居民意见。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My new manager gives me more autonomy at work.
cards.example_zh: 我的新经理给了我更多工作自主权。
cards.explain_zh: 通常不可数；既指地区自治，也指个人或机构自主。

cards.example_en: Giving schools greater autonomy may help teachers adapt their lessons to the specific needs of local communities.
cards.example_zh: 赋予学校更大的自主权，可能有助于教师根据当地社区的具体需求调整课程。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Ticket availability is low for the evening concert.
cards.example_zh: 晚场音乐会剩下的票已经很少了。

cards.example_en: The proof begins with an axiom accepted by all members of the class.
cards.example_zh: 这个证明从全班都接受的一条公理开始。

cards.example_en: The globe spins smoothly around its tilted axis.
cards.example_zh: 这个地球仪绕着倾斜的轴平稳转动。
cards.explain_zh: 复数是 axes /ˈæksiːz/，注意与 axe 的复数区分。

cards.example_en: The horizontal axis shows time, allowing readers to compare changes in employment across the period.
cards.example_zh: 横轴表示时间，方便读者比较该时期内的就业变化。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: He took a backward step to avoid the puddle.
cards.example_zh: 他向后退了一步，以避开水坑。
cards.explain_zh: 英式副词常用 backwards；用来形容人落后可能冒犯。

cards.example_en: He took a backward step to avoid the puddle.
cards.example_zh: 他向后退了一步，以避开水坑。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Some bacteria help digest food, while others can cause serious illness.
cards.example_zh: 有些细菌帮助消化食物，另一些则可能引起严重疾病。

cards.example_en: Prompt treatment of bacterial infections can reduce the risk of septic shock and improve patient outcomes.
cards.example_zh: 及时治疗细菌感染可以降低脓毒性休克的风险，改善患者的治疗结果。
cards.source: Word Atlas context; product gloss correction

cards.example_en: Don't bang the door; Grandpa is asleep.
cards.example_zh: 不要用力关门，爷爷在睡觉。

cards.example_en: This warm winter coat was a real bargain.
cards.example_zh: 这件暖和的冬季外套买得真划算。
cards.explain_zh: 便宜货用可数名词；bargain with sb表示与某人议价。

cards.example_en: This warm winter coat was a real bargain.
cards.example_zh: 这件暖和的冬季外套买得真划算。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Excessive artificial lighting in urban areas can disrupt wildlife behaviour and reduce the visibility of stars.
word.example_zh: 城市中过量的人工照明会扰乱野生动物的行为，并使星星难以看清。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: The horizontal axis represents time, while the vertical axis shows changes in average household energy consumption.
word.example_zh: 横坐标轴表示时间，纵坐标轴显示家庭平均能源消耗的变化。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0
